'''Eliya''' was a [[Seanchan]] ''[[morat'raken]]''. She was co-rider with [[Chulein]].

== Activities ==
She was investigating a large group of [[Kin]]s women and [[Sea Folk]] at the [[Kin]]'s farm just outside of [[Ebou Dar]]. She fell off the back of her ''[[raken]]'' when a [[Gateway]] was unraveled wrongly and explodes.
